doc.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016

title: Favorite new groups
summary: He likes The Internet, Hiatus Kaiyote and a London singer.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: I was going to ask who are you listening to most right now. Who are your favorite groups?
Yeah favorite groups or artists coming up kind of right now.

I haven’t been listening as much these last few months because I’ve been going to so many projects on my own. And when I do projects on my own I purposely don’t listen to a lot of other stuff. Honestly. But I like The Internet. I just kind of got hip to them last year. I like them, they have good vibes. I like Hiatus. They have good vibes. Those two
groups, as far as new rising, up-and-coming cats. You know what I mean? I like those people. I like Laura Namulemu. You know Laura Namulemu? She’s from London.
